g.text: # Tuesday. A new Claude Code session. No chat history from Monday's Codex session.
Goal Cut median checkout time from 62s to under 30s (2/6 tasks done)
In progress single-payment-call · Collapse authorize and capture into one API call
Blocked provider-sandbox · waiting on finance to request keys
Handoff codex → claude-code: add an idempotency key so client retries
never double-charge, then run the combined capture test
Next hp finish … before you stop
> Pick up where the team left off.
● First I'm adding an idempotency key to POST /payments in api, which keeps the
critical single-payment-call task moving. The handoff calls for it so client
retries can never double-charge, and the combined-capture test has to wait for
